description: The `impai-observe` fixture, under true line of sight. Three computer seats and an idle human seat on Core Prime Industrial Area, for ImpAI's observation (tagpu/ddraw/src/tagpu_impai.c): seats 1 and 2 are `impai`, so the launch writes `seatai=1,2` into the store; 3 is the control, OTA AI. The stock AI plays every seat; ImpAI only observes.
